[color=#ffff00][head=3]Roleplay Standards[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]Triad's focus is as an MRP server, where players can create stories and roleplay. Activity that breaks immersion should be avoided at all times as it can have a negative impact upon the experiences of others.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.1[/color] Your character is expected to be a believable person that fits within the lore of the Triad sector. Do not design a character that in any way is in breach of the lore or any other rule simply by existing. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.2[/color] Your character is a separate entity from you, the player. Your character's actions, feelings, and knowledge in-game should be based solely on the character's experiences rather than your own as the player. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.3[/color] In-character names must not make obvious references or be a play on words, and must not be obscene. They must not include Job Titles as a way to gain an advantage. ★
[color=#a4885c]IR.4[/color] All characters must both be and act in a way resembling the age of adulthood. Any characters in violation of this are strictly forbidden. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.5[/color] Do not attempt to impersonate another character without their OOC consent. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.6[/color] Characters do not have any knowledge of what happened while they were dead, sleeping, or in critical condition. Upon returning to life you will have forgotten 10 minutes leading up to your death, with only vague memories of how you died, but never who or what killed you. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.7[/color] Characters who die and return via spawning into the round are to act as a freshly joined participant to the round and as a separate entity to their previous self. The exception to this is ‘cryocycling’ to fix bugs or cloning issues to reset your body. [color=#f1c232]★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]IR.8[/color] Ship names must be of a reasonable standard for an MRP server, and something the TFA would have authorised a ship to be called. For example, do not name a ship "Goober" or "MeowMeowMeow". ★
[color=#a4885c]IR.9[/color] Do not directly refer to internet culture or use netspeak whilst talking as your character, for example "lol" or "skibidi toilet". ★
